chars.STEPMOM: a Moroccan woman about 35, dark wavy hair in a loose bun, emerald green velvet house kaftan with gold trim, gold hoop earrings
chars.DAD: a Moroccan man about 50, short grey hair and grey moustache, navy blue technician work overalls with a white company patch
chars.SON: a thin Moroccan boy about 13, red hoodie, black track pants, short curly black hair
